advice.headline: Make a trade

moves.text: Offer Fat Camp: Tre' Harris + Courtland Sutton for Jaylen Waddle.

reasons: You're 11-5 and make the playoffs in >99% of simulated seasons. Your title chance is 18%.
A top-2 seed matters: you win the title 29% of the time with the first-round bye and 13% without it. You get the bye in 26% of seasons right now.
Your projected playoff-week lineup ranks 3rd of 8 contenders (174.0 points a week).
Your weakest position is WR (10th of 12), so that's where an upgrade helps most.
Looking ahead, your roster projects 3rd in 2026, 2nd in 2027 and 2nd in 2028 (title chances about 18%, 23%, 16%), after aging and the rookies your picks will bring.
Your roster holds up for the next two seasons too, so you can afford to push for titles now.

That trade raises your title chance from 18% to 21%, and your lineup comes out 1.3 points a week ahead overall. Tre' Harris + Courtland Sutton add 2.1 points a week for you today, but Jaylen Waddle is worth more to your lineup.
The trade values are close enough for them to say yes (you give 2,156, get 1,889), though it costs their lineup 1.2 a week, so expect some pushback.
It doesn't cost your future: title chances in the next two seasons go from 23% and 16% to 27% and 20%.
You have 5 weeks until the trade deadline.
watch: Michael Wilson is Questionable. He's one of your most important players (3.9 points a week).

Jordan Love's trade value has dropped 13% in 16 days.
Amon-Ra St. Brown's trade value has dropped 12% in 16 days.
